title: Zesty Crunchy Ukrainian Date Skewers
description: A festive Ukrainian dish featuring pitted dates, lardons-render, and a flexitarian-friendly twist, perfect for snacking. This recipe combines fermented flavors with crunchy textures.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, whisk together apple cider vinegar, honey, dried thyme, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the pitted dates to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread a date onto a skewer, followed by a lardon, and repeat for a total of 6 skewers.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush with olive oil.
Bake the skewers in the preheated oven for 12 minutes, or until the lardons are crispy.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
Serve the Zesty Crunchy Ukrainian Date Skewers warm, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
